review.title: Wheat SynCom-SASW01: source-stock boundaries and native descriptor correspondence
review.independence_basis: Authored bounded source-provenance and database assessment. A sibling independently read the source-note plan against primary Methods2.1 and complete native results; the parent independently reviewed exact note and mapping candidates, the actual note checkpoint and source context. Shared writer, engine, checker and builder were independently reviewed previously. This assessment is self-review, not independent whole-record scientific approval.
review.summary: Two actual guarded M5 transitions separate the study's 16S-based FN0603/FWP1205 identities from database reference populations, then store the complete pinned native descriptor results. FN0603 retains three name-route alternatives without selecting a study-stock species. FWP1205's exact NCBITaxon299767 descriptor records the native296-genome/.95 correspondence without claiming an experimental-stock genome classification. Corrected notes, all five stocks, the other three mappings, biological content and old history remain unchanged in the second transition.

limitations: Partial technical/source-provenance assessment with scientific_review:false. No whole-record scientific approval, corpus QC pass, automatic issue closure or release clearance follows from this bundle.

The native crosswalk release is not established. FN0603's descriptor resolves by ncbi_name with no exact NCBITaxon158836 row. Its three options do not classify that study stock's genome or define a reference-genome denominator.

The exact NCBITaxon299767 correspondence's total296 and majority fraction0.95 describe the reference population, not296 genomes from FWP1205 or a probability of that stock's identity. GROUNDED describes the stored descriptor correspondence, not a demonstrated experimental assembly placement.

Primary evidence scope is the retained article's stated 16S V5-V7 identification method and five-stock roster. No independent reanalysis of marker resolution, exact-study genome placement, isolation-trait supplements, field outcomes or all mechanistic claims was performed.

The first transition's eight checks establish the note-only intermediate and remain summarized in its bound checkpoint. They are not relabeled as final-byte checks. The eight required checks below are actual commands against final mapping bytes, including one new native sidecar.
Local and M5 NCBI file-stat observations are retained separately; no whole-database checksum or release is certified. Source, crosswalk, native code, application and assessment inputs are hash-bound.

Existing BCC-versus-NC treatment scope, EPS hypothesis, relative amplicon/viability boundaries, predicted pathways, yield/abundance findings and S1/S2 isolation-trait discussion remain preserved. Issue1952 is not cleared by this diagnostic.

Reference validation, generated pages, actual composite historical admission and combined full QC remain separately accounted work. This bundle preserves both transition inputs for subsequent strict proof; it does not claim that integration has already passed.
